level.theme: Mysterious ancient ruins with hidden mechanisms and environmental hazards
level.setting: A crumbling underwater temple with bioluminescent algae, statues, and pressure plates

pickup.name: Tidal Crystal
pickup.effect: Enhances seismic attacks and manipulates water currents

encounters.trigger: Player activates pressure plate to unlock hidden path

enemy.name: Electrocurrent Eel
enemy.weakness: Tidal Crystal's energy disrupts electric field

pickup.name: Stabilizer Core
pickup.effect: Creates temporary platforms and bypasses traps

encounters.trigger: Stabilizer Core activates mechanism to open boss chamber door

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars and laser grids

pickup.name: Crystalline Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Defeating guardian triggers boss awakening sequence

boss.name: The Abyssal Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Weaken the core with Tidal Crystal seismic waves

level.objective: Navigate the ancient temple, retrieve pickups, and defeat the abyssal guardian
level.reward: Access to deeper oceanic realms and unique geomantic abilities

level.theme: Serene underwater exploration with hidden dangers
level.setting: A tranquil coral reef and sunken temple, with soft blue lighting filtering through the water and gentle currents carrying marine life.

encounters.hazard: The Jellyfish releases toxic tentacles that reduce player movement speed.

pickup.name: Coral Shard
pickup.effect: Increases Beastmaster companion's attack speed by 20%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jellyfish clears the path to the sunken temple.

encounters.hazard: The Eel creates electrical fields that stun the player for 2 seconds on contact.

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Beacon
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to emit light, revealing hidden paths and enemy weak points.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Eel's nest activates a mechanism that opens the gate to the final trench.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Bioluminescent Beacon (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Leviathan by targeting its bioluminescent core with the Bioluminescent Beacon.

level.objective: Navigate through the underwater ruins to confront the Abyssal Leviathan, using pickups obtained from prior encounters to exploit enemy weaknesses.
level.reward: Aqua Attunement (permanent ability to breathe underwater and swim faster)

level.setting: A dark, sunken city surrounded by jagged coral formations and ghostly apparitions. The water is thick with bioluminescent algae, casting an eerie green glow. Distant, muffled sounds of the abyss echo through the ruins.

pickup.name: Tidebound Amulet
pickup.effect: Enhances necromancy spells by 30%

encounters.trigger: The guardian's destruction collapses a barrier, revealing a path to the flooded crypt.

pickup.name: Ancient Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Leviathan's chamber

encounters.trigger: Defeating the warden triggers a mechanism that reveals the Leviathan's lair, guarded by a pressure plate requiring the Ancient Key.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 while exploiting weakness

level.objective: Defeat the Leviathan of the Abyss
level.reward: Coral Crown (increases underwater movement speed by 20%)

level.theme: Tense, claustrophobic environment with collapsing walls and unpredictable hazards
level.setting: Ancient underwater research facility with flickering lights and unstable structures

encounters.location: Main corridor of the research facility

pickup.name: Storm Core
pickup.effect: Charges lightning attacks by 50%

encounters.trigger: Explosion clears a blocked pathway to the next area

encounters.location: Crystal chamber with unstable energy fields

pickup.name: Pressure Valve
pickup.effect: Disables pressure plate sealing the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Destroying the guardian unlocks the boss chamber

boss.name: Leviathan Sovereign
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the shield with the Pressure Valve, then reduce health to 0%

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing research facility to confront the Leviathan Sovereign
level.reward: Access to deeper underwater zones and a unique storm aura ability

level.theme: Eerie underwater ruins haunted by spectral echoes of drowned sailors
level.setting: Sunken city ruins with bioluminescent fungi, crumbling statues, and ghostly flicker lights
level.player_weapon: Shadow Dagger (stealth strikes, dark energy charge)

enemy.name: Crystalline Guardian
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon: Shadow Dagger (cuts through crystalline structures)

encounters.hazard: Toxic algae spores that impair vision

pickup.name: Shadow Crystal
pickup.effect: Unlocks dark energy charge ability for the shadow dagger

encounters.trigger: Destroying the guardian's crystal core opens a path to the submerged temple

enemy.name: Gelatinous Abomination
enemy.weakness: Shadow Crystal (absorbs and redirects dark energy)

pickup.name: Resonance Core
pickup.effect: Disrupts energy shields of the final boss

encounters.trigger: The abomination's gelatinous form blocks the path to the sunken city until defeated

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.weakness: Resonance Core (obtained from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Overload the boss's energy core with the resonance core, then strike with the shadow dagger.

level.objective: Navigate through the eerie underwater ruins to confront the Leviathan of the Abyss
level.reward: Abyssal Wristguard (grants temporary invisibility in dark zones)

level.theme: Chaotic underwater environment with environmental hazards and unpredictable enemy behavior
level.setting: A sunken city with collapsing structures, bioluminescent caverns, and a volcanic trench

pickup.name: Combustion Core
pickup.effect: Increases fire attack damage by 30%

encounters.trigger: Player must ignite a series of underwater beacons to unlock the path to the second area

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas vents and shifting currents

pickup.name: Thermal Conductor
pickup.effect: Allows bypassing energy shields

encounters.trigger: The Thermal Conductor is required to disable the kraken's energy shield before it can be damaged

boss.name: Thermic Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Break its molten core using the Thermal Conductor

level.objective: Reach the volcanic trench and defeat the Thermic Leviathan
level.reward: Thermic Leviathan's molten core (permanent fire damage boost)

level.theme: Desolation and isolation, with the player battling both the environment and enemies to survive.
level.setting: A desolate, sunken city with crumbling structures, bioluminescent algae, and distant echoes of long-dead machinery. The water is murky and cold, with limited visibility and frequent tremors.
level.player_weapon: Plasma Torch (can be upgraded with Echo Core and Deep Core Reactor)

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Sonic Disruptor Upgrade

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Eel's nest triggers a collapsing ceiling, revealing a path to the next chamber.

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas pockets and shifting sand traps

pickup.name: Deep Core Reactor
pickup.effect: Grants access to Deep Core Reactor (one-time use)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan breaches the submersible bay's hull, releasing the Abyssal Warden from containment.

encounters.hazard: Oxygen depletes rapidly; environment becomes unstable

pickup.name: Abyssal Relic
pickup.effect: Unlocks permanent weapon upgrade: Reactor-Fueled Plasma Torch

encounters.trigger: The Leviathan's defeat destabilizes the citadel, forcing the player into the final chamber.

boss.name: Abyssal Warden
boss.weakness: Deep Core Reactor (obtained from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Deep Core Reactor

level.objective: Reach the citadel's core and destroy the Abyssal Warden, using pickups from prior encounters.

level.setting: A vibrant underwater world with bioluminescent coral, playful sea creatures, and sunken treasure chests that glow with magical energy. The environment shifts colors with the player's illusions, enhancing the whimsical atmosphere.

pickup.name: Luminous Pearl
pickup.effect: Amplifies the prism weapon's decoy effect

encounters.trigger: Player must use the prism to create a decoy, luring the jellyfish into a trap that reveals the Luminous Pearl

pickup.name: Chromatic Lens
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see through illusions

encounters.trigger: The Mirror Eel's reflections are disrupted by the Luminous Pearl, revealing a hidden compartment containing the Chromatic Lens

pickup.name: Refraction Core
pickup.effect: Destroys illusion-based mimicry

encounters.trigger: The Chromatic Lens reveals the Bubblesnake's true form, allowing the player to collect the Refraction Core from its lair

boss.name: Mimic Leviathan
boss.weakness: Refraction Core (obtained from the Bubblesnake encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Break the mimicry by targeting the Refraction Core

level.objective: Navigate the underwater realm, outwit whimsical foes, and uncover the secret of the Mimic Leviathan.
level.reward: Unlock the ability to cast permanent illusions in future levels

level.theme: Chaotic jungle with unpredictable environmental hazards and interconnected encounters.
level.setting: A dense, overgrown jungle with active environmental hazards like falling trees, quicksand patches, and toxic fog. The terrain shifts unpredictably during combat, forcing the player to adapt quickly.

encounters.hazard: Collapsing vines and falling boulders during combat.

pickup.name: Molten Ember
pickup.effect: Unlocks fire-based attacks for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Serpent's death triggers a cave-in, revealing the Thornspire Hive's lair.

encounters.hazard: Toxic fog that reduces player movement speed by 50%.

pickup.name: Venom Vial
pickup.effect: Poison enemies for 5 seconds on contact

encounters.trigger: Destroying the hive removes a magical barrier, granting access to the Jungle Spirit's chamber.

boss.name: The Jungle Spirit
boss.weakness: Venom Vial (obtained from Thornspire Hive in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Venom Vial to weaken its core during its third phase.

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic jungle and defeat The Jungle Spirit using pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Jungle Beastmaster's Relic (unlocks a temporary beast companion that deals fire damage)

level.setting: A dense, mist-shrouded jungle with ancient stone ruins and bioluminescent flora. The air hums with unseen energy, and the ground shifts unpredictably underfoot.

pickup.name: Bramble Vial
pickup.effect: Apply poison resistance debuff to enemies

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Viper Shaman to reveal a hidden path through the fog

pickup.name: Mirror Shard
pickup.effect: Reflective surface that disrupts energy attacks

encounters.trigger: Use Bramble Vial to dissolve thorns and access the cave

boss.name: The Guardian of the Veil
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the reflective shield using the Mirror Shard

level.objective: Retrieve the Mirror Shard from the jungle's heart to defeat the Guardian of the Veil
level.reward: Jungle Survival Kit (contains 3 healing potions and 1 Mirror Shard)

level.theme: Tense, high-stakes survival in a hostile environment. Enemies react to noise, and failure results in immediate death.
level.setting: Dense jungle with ancient ruins, toxic swamps, and overgrown temples. Constant ambient sounds of wildlife and distant thunder.
level.player_weapon: Silver Dagger (poison damage, bypasses venom resistance)

enemy.name: Poison Viper
enemy.weakness: Player's starting weapon: Silver Dagger (bypasses venom resistance)

encounters.hazard: Swamp Gas (randomly appears, reduces visibility and movement speed)

pickup.name: Incendiary Cache
pickup.effect: Fire Bomb (explodes on contact, deals 50 fire damage)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the viper clears the swamp gas, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Traps (pressure plates trigger spears; requires stealth to avoid)

pickup.name: Shaman's Altar
pickup.effect: Echo Relic (disrupts magical entities)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the shaman's magical wards with the fire bomb unlocks the temple's inner sanctum, where the boss awaits.

boss.name: Jungle Spirit of the Temple
boss.weakness: Echo Relic (obtained from the shaman in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the spirit using the 'Echo Relic' to disrupt its magical aura.

level.objective: Stealthily navigate the jungle ruins, defeat three threats, and destroy the jungle spirit using the Echo Relic.
level.reward: Jungle Survival Badge (unlocks new stealth abilities)

level.setting: A lush, misty jungle filled with bioluminescent flora, a tranquil river, and ancient stone ruins. The air hums with the sounds of distant wildlife and rustling leaves.

pickup.name: Serenity Shard
pickup.effect: Increases calming ability, allowing the player to pacify hostile flora.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Jaguar clears the mist, revealing a path through the thicket.

pickup.name: Jungle Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final chamber leading to the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Using the Serenity Shard on the Thorns' Wrath causes the vines to retract, revealing a stone door adorned with carvings.

boss.name: Storm Spirit
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its weakness to the Serenity Shard.

level.objective: Protect the jungle's balance by pacifying its guardians and confronting the chaotic Storm Spirit.
level.reward: A medallion symbolizing harmony with nature, granting a permanent 10% damage reduction against environmental hazards.

level.setting: A dense, ominous jungle with overgrown ruins, glowing fungi, and thick mist. Eerie sounds and the feeling of being watched permeate the environment.

pickup.name: Cinder Core
pickup.effect: Power-up necromancy spells or used as a fire projectile

encounters.trigger: Defeating the guardian collapses a wall, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

enemy.name: Corrupted Spirit
enemy.weakness: Energy attacks powered by Cinder Core

pickup.name: Shadow Veil
pickup.effect: Reveals invisible enemies and negates darkness effects

encounters.trigger: Defeating the spirit dispels a curse on an altar, activating a teleportation circle to the next area.

pickup.name: Jungle Heart
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Defeating the stalker removes a barrier, revealing the boss arena.

boss.name: Viperfang Queen
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the jewel on its head using the Shadow Veil's light.

level.objective: Navigate the cursed jungle and defeat the Viperfang Queen.
level.reward: Jungle Heart (unlocks access to hidden areas)

level.theme: Whimsical jungle exploration with alchemical challenges
level.setting: A vibrant, enchanted jungle with talking flora and whimsical hazards
level.player_weapon: Acid Vial (can be upgraded with Jungle Essence)

encounters.hazard: A magical parrot blocks the path with a vine trap, giggling as it flaps its wings

pickup.name: Bramble Seed
pickup.effect: Can be used to craft a fire potion

encounters.trigger: Defeating the parrot with the Acid Vial causes the vines to retract, revealing a hidden trail

enemy.name: Vine Golem
enemy.weakness: Fire (crafted using Bramble Seed from 1st encounter)

encounters.hazard: A corrupted plant guardian blocks a stone bridge with thorny vines

pickup.name: Jungle Essence
pickup.effect: Boosts alchemical potency when combined with other ingredients

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Vine Golem with fire reveals a glowing path to the sacred grove

boss.name: Verdant Guardian
boss.weakness: Acid Vial (initial weapon) and Jungle Essence (pickup from 2nd encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Deal 180 damage using a combination of the Acid Vial and Jungle Essence

level.objective: Navigate the enchanted jungle to confront the Verdant Guardian
level.reward: Jungle Amulet (grants immunity to plant-based hazards)

level.setting: A jungle where time fractures randomly, causing plants to grow backwards, creatures to phase in and out of existence, and the sky to flicker between past/future states
level.player_weapon: Chronogun (fires time-locked projectiles that bypass temporal distortions)

encounters.hazard: The leviathan's time loops cause random temporal distortions (player takes 5 damage per second during distortions)

pickup.name: Time Crystal
pickup.effect: Time Crystal (activates chronogun's 'Temporal Lock' mode, allowing 3x damage against time-based enemies)

encounters.trigger: Player must break the leviathan's time loop by firing 3 consecutive time-locked projectiles at its temporal core

encounters.hazard: The warden creates ghostly duplicates that phase in and out of time (player takes 20% increased damage from duplicates)

pickup.name: Temporal Anchor
pickup.effect: Temporal Anchor (allows player to stabilize time manipulation for 10 seconds, reducing damage taken by 50%)

encounters.trigger: Player must use the Time Crystal to disrupt the warden's temporal cloak, revealing its true form

encounters.hazard: The mimicreaper duplicates the player's chronomancy abilities (player must differentiate between real and mimic attacks)

pickup.name: Chronogun Upgrade
pickup.effect: Chronogun Upgrade: 'Rift Penetration' (increases time crystal damage by 50%)

encounters.trigger: Player must activate the temporal anchor to create a stable time field, revealing the mimicreaper's weakness

boss.name: Chrono-Rift Guardian
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the temporal rift core with the time crystal

level.objective: Navigate the corrupted jungle to repair the temporal rift causing the eerie phenomenon
level.reward: Time-Resonance Amulet (allows player to rewind 5 seconds of damage taken)

level.theme: Survival through relentless combat; the jungle itself seems to conspire against the player, with hazards and enemies working in tandem to hinder progress.
level.setting: A desolate, overgrown jungle with skeletal trees, fog, and the sound of distant howls. The ground is littered with the bones of previous travelers, and the air is thick with decay.
level.player_weapon: Greatsword of Rage (base damage: 300, +50% damage when enraged)

pickup.name: Frenzy Relic
pickup.effect: Frenzy Relic: +25% damage when Rage is active

encounters.trigger: Player must break through the Jagua's carapace to access the relic hidden in its chest.

pickup.name: Berserker's Amulet
pickup.effect: Berserker's Amulet: 30% damage reduction against elemental attacks

encounters.trigger: Player must use the Frenzy Relic to ignite the Guardian's core, revealing a path to the amulet embedded in the ground.

boss.name: The Devouring Spirit
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Spirit's Core with the Berserker's Amulet

level.objective: Reach the corrupted temple at the jungle's heart and defeat the Devouring Spirit
